pr_body:
If `progress == Distance`, we must not move again on the same tick, but still `return true` to avoid losing a tick in the case
when this is the last `Move` tick followed by a different activity (or a new queued `Move`, for example via waypoints).

Fixes #19347.
pr_comments:
This doesn't appear to be sufficient to solve the issue, or maybe i'm doing something silly.

Testcase:
* Apply rule changes from 8ef025a283c8f861f4c7a04623e07bd98a3ca9cb
* Line up 1tnk, 2tnk, 3tnk next to eachother facing a long strip of clear terrain
* Pause the game and use the `/terrainoverlay` to issue move orders in a straight line
* Unpause and watch the three tanks race

The Medium Tank surges ahead with noticable jerks showing that it is still double-ticking.

Updated.

Fingers crossed, but I think I got it. Passes the above testcase now, at least.

Changed the approach to tracking the world tick we're on, which I believe makes for cleaner and easier-to-understand code, too.
Good idea. I think we might now be able to remove the `firstTick` stuff and simplify the comment too?
Updated, but put the changes in a separate commit for now.
LGTM otherwise and I didn't see any problems with a quick test ingame after making the above change. So :+1: after addressing that and squashing.

issue_context.title: With "move jumpy-ness" fix, speed of 128 results in faster movement than it should
issue_context.body:
If a ground unit is given a speed of 128, with a locomotor that travels at 100% speed on clear, it will travel much faster than it should (racing ahead of otherwise identical units with speeds of 127 and 129).

If 100% speed on clear is used, 128 would be the new speed for the APC and Phase Tank in the RA mod.

Pertains to: https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/pull/19220
comments: I've confirmed the regression but haven't looked into why it happens.

review_comments: Minor nit: It would be more robust to set this before calling `OnComplete`, as this makes sure that any future code changes that might read `Move.lastMovePartCompletedTick` from the `MovePart` ctor see the same value.
